articles.headline: NextCure and Avere Therapeutics Announce Merger to Advance Once-Weekly Oral IL-23 Therapy
articles.summary: NextCure and Avere announced a proposed stock merger and concurrent $320 million private financing to support an oral IL-23 development program. Closing, financing and future trials remained subject to conditions; the announcement does not establish completed funding or regulatory approval.
